source: lab (real Orbbec Femto Mega recording; people + ball cut out with Segment Anything 2 and pasted on a synthetic static blue-white gradient background)

camera.motion: static (catcher's shoes and the static background stay at the same pixels in all 49 frames)
camera.intrinsics_from_benchmark: focal length f = 0.5959 * 1280 = 763 px, principal point ~ (640, 360)
camera.roll: people appear tilted: the catcher's standing body axis is ~29 deg from image vertical (feet lower-left, head upper-right) and the thrower leans the same way -> camera is rolled/tilted by roughly 25-30 deg; image x/y are NOT world horizontal/vertical
camera.ground_plane: not visible (background replaced). Only cue: catcher's shoes at image y ~375-437 (her feet on the floor). No horizon or vanishing points.
camera.watermark: 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' box at x 1030-1280, y 690-720

objects.name: ball
objects.description: black-and-white soccer ball (white with black pentagons, 'Franklin' logo and '=100=' print)
objects.reference_point: visible centre of the ball (circle centre; centre of the blur streak when blurred)
objects.depth_trend: apparent size shrinks steadily through the flight: ball moves away from the camera from the near thrower to the far catcher, then further away as she pulls it in to her body (frames 44-48)

objects.name: thrower
objects.description: near person at the LEFT edge, light-grey T-shirt, dark trousers, glasses, face blurred; mostly outside the frame (only left part of torso, head, arms visible)
objects.role: holds the ball (0-25), winds up, throws underarm/two-handed toward the catcher (release ~frame 30/31), arms then drop
objects.track: tracks/thrower.csv (bbox of visible mask; x0 always 0, y1 always 719; partial body only)

objects.name: catcher
objects.description: far person at the RIGHT, dark-grey oversized T-shirt, black trousers with white drawstrings, white sneakers, long brown hair, face blurred; head top cut by the image top edge
objects.role: stands in place (feet do not move), raises arms from ~frame 34-36, catches the ball at frames 41-44 and holds it in front of her body

static_extents_frame0_px.note: length is a lower bound of her height in pixels because the top of the head is cut at y = 0
static_extents_frame0_px.right_shoe_px: x 968-1005, y 405-437 (lowest point of the person: y ~437-439)

static_objects: none besides the synthetic background (no furniture, floor markings or props)

events.event: ball held almost still in thrower's hands
events.detail: centre wanders within ~(318-330, 528-554) px; Hough noise ~+-4 px

events.event: wind-up: ball moves down-left toward thrower's hip
release: first frame with ball free

events.detail: ball moves 88 px between 35 and 36 vs 58 and 35 px for neighbouring steps, and blur length (~20-27 px) indicates ~45 px per frame; positions are real (checked on crops)

events.event: apex of the image trajectory (minimum image y ~70)
events.detail: image y only, camera is rolled
hands under the ball; firm contact with forearm/hands at frame 42 (t 1.75)
ball drifts down/right toward her body (944,162) -> (970,235)

files.tracks/catcher.csv: frame,time_s,ref_x/ref_y = mask centroid, bbox, mask_area_px, occluded, note
files.tracks/thrower.csv: same columns as catcher; partial body only
